test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Argue loudly about unimportant things
solution: The correct answer is **"Squabble."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Squabble"** means to argue or quarrel noisily over a trivial matter. (छोटी-मोटी बात पर झगड़ा) • **Example**: *Polly and Susie were having a **squabble**__ about who was going to hold the dog's lead.* • It is a one-word substitute for **"argue loudly about unimportant things."** • The correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Maintain** means to keep or hold on to something. (किसी वस्‍तु को उसी स्‍तर, मानक आदि पर बनाए रखना, जारी रखना) • **Disagree** means to have a different opinion or belief than someone else. ((किसी से) अलग राय रखना या होना; सहमत न होना) • **Agree** means to have the same opinion or belief as someone else. (किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति से सहमत होना; एकमत होना) 35:Tbee, The correct answer is **"Hospitable."**
